verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's product page says the RTX PRO 6000 is optimized for CUDA-X libraries such as RAPIDS and that its Transformer Engine accelerates AI work in PyTorch and TensorFlow. The CUDA Toolkit docs describe a compiler, runtime and libraries for deploying on desktop workstations. A hands-on community report shows four of these cards running inference workloads, but another user notes that SM120 lacks tmem/tcgen05 and that major libraries focus on SM100. Missing for 10: an explicit CUDA documentation entry listing this part or its SM120 compute capability as a supported target, and evidence that key libraries fully support SM120-specific features.
